hook: Planning a weekend trip to the mountains.

lines.speaker: anna
lines.text: Are you going to take the bus this weekend?

translation.vi: Bạn có định đi xe buýt vào cuối tuần này không?

lines.speaker: ben
lines.text: Yes, I'm going to take a trip to the mountains.

translation.vi: Ừ, mình định đi một chuyến lên núi.

gloss.en: a time when you go somewhere and come back

grammar_notes: Use 'going to' + verb to talk about plans. Example: 'I'm going to take a trip.'
interaction_prompts: Where are you going to go this weekend?
